name: Relics of the Past
prologue: To better understand our future, we must first understand our past. It didn’t take long for the reports of Miskatonic University’s failed expedition to the jungles of Mexico to reach your ears. Stories of step pyramids, mythical serpent-people, and otherworldly artifacts in places previously thought uninhabited have piqued your interest. It didn’t take you long to pack your bags and make plans to head down and investigate it yourself. The Miskatonic University expedition made it into the ruins but struggled to make any progress. Your heart races as you begin to consider what other forgotten treasures lie undiscovered in the heart of the tomb.
